run_optimizer_benchmark: run the perf function to benchmark a nevergrad optimizer on a synthetic overfitting task
run_single_optimizer_with_timeout: run the subgo function to benchmark a single optimizer with a 600 second timeout
run_full_benchmark_suite: run the go function to benchmark all optimizers across multiple budgets in parallel
display_benchmark_results: display the display_losses function to format benchmark scores as sorted text output
draw_performance_charts: draw the draw function to generate matplotlib charts comparing optimizer performance across budgets
